comparison.objective: Extend a spring-return tape and mark a board at 300 mm; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper stop at 90°.
comparison.physical_skill: Requires resisting tape retraction while placing a pen mark, not coaxial screw driving with a thin-nut wrench and countertorque.
comparison.success_condition: Checks mark position, tape extension, and pen release; candidate checks stop angle, locking hardware, repeated actuation, drift, and tool withdrawal.
comparison.reason: Although both preserve a setting against a restoring force, the record tests simultaneous measuring and marking rather than mechanical lock-setting retention.
